title: Hyblock
description: A Handcrafted and Customized Modpack for Hypixel Skyblock 1.21.10
body:
### Handcrafted SkyBlock Modpack

This modpack is carefully handcrafted by **UrLocalSwede** with a strong focus on optimization, usability, and overall quality. It is designed specifically for **Hypixel SkyBlock**, aiming to provide the best possible client-side experience while staying fully compliant with the server’s rules.

The pack includes a curated selection of the most useful **client-side mods**, chosen to improve performance, quality of life, and in-game efficiency. Every mod serves a clear purpose, helping streamline gameplay, reduce unnecessary friction, and enhance the overall SkyBlock experience without giving unfair advantages.

In addition to gameplay improvements, the modpack also features several **visual enhancements**, including carefully selected visual mods and resource packs. These additions subtly improve lighting, UI clarity, and general aesthetics, making the game more immersive and visually appealing while maintaining strong performance and stability.

All components of the modpack are tested to work well together, ensuring a smooth, lightweight, and reliable experience. The goal is to offer a balanced modpack that feels modern, clean, and practical—perfect for both casual SkyBlock players and more experienced grinders who want an optimized setup without unnecessary clutter.
